screen1-a1.initial_rationale: unlabeled speech bubble is the messaging convention; exemption pending the tap
screen1-a1.deciding_evidence: carried from screen26-a1 (same control, tested once): the speech bubble opened the Messages view, matching the chat convention

screen1-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Search"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen1-a2.convention_relied_on: magnifying glass = search; my reading, confidence high
screen1-a2.initial_rationale: unlabeled, but the magnifier is a universal search convention; exemption applies pending the tap

test_cases.confirms_if: anything other than a search view opens

screen1-a4.glyph: plus sign on a filled square
screen1-a4.description: right end of the toolbar under 'Messages'
screen1-a4.visible_text: none (white plus on a filled square, right of the 'Messages' heading)
screen1-a4.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "New Message"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen1-a4.convention_relied_on: plus = create/add a new item; with the 'Messages' heading beside it, reads as a new message; my reading, confidence medium

test_cases.confirms_if: it opens something other than creating a new message (e.g. add friend)

screen1-a5.visible_text: "ATs" (initials on a rounded tile; three identical tiles in the rail)
screen1-a5.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Accessibility Testin's server"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen1-a5.initial_rationale: three tiles carry the identical abbreviation 'ATs' and nothing else; a first-time user cannot tell what the tiles are or tell them apart

test_cases.expected_result: a place identified by the tile opens
test_cases.confirms_if: the destination cannot be told apart from the other tiles' destinations
test_cases.overturns_if: each tile leads somewhere visibly distinct
test_cases.observed_result: it opened a server view headed "Accessibility Testin's server" with Server Boosts, Text Channels #general, Voice Channels General (live app at test time showed four identical 'ATs' tiles in the rail where the capture shows three; layout otherwise identical)

test_cases.confirms_if: the second tile opens a view indistinguishable from the first
test_cases.overturns_if: the second tile opens something visibly different
test_cases.observed_result: it opened a server view with the identical heading "Accessibility Testin's server" and identical channel list; only the rail highlight moved

screen1-a5.deciding_evidence: identical 'ATs' tiles lead to identically named, identically laid-out servers; nothing visible says what a tile is or which is which
screen1-a5.recommendation: show the full server name under or beside each tile (and a 'Servers' caption on the rail); give each server a distinct visible name or icon
